name: 1stdibs
description: The most beautiful things on earth. Shop antique furniture, fine jewelry, vintage fashion and art from top sellers around the world.

interface.longDescription: Bring 1stDibs into your conversation. Describe what you're looking for, whether it's a mid-century lounge chair, an Art Deco diamond ring, a vintage Chanel jacket or a landscape painting for a particular wall, and ChatGPT searches more than a million extraordinary vintage, antique and contemporary pieces of furniture, art, fine jewelry and fashion. Refine by the categories and filters you'd find on 1stDibs, such as style, period, material or where the seller is located, or simply browse a category to see what's out there.
defaultPrompt: Find a mid-century modern walnut credenza under $10,000
Show me Art Deco diamond engagement rings
What vintage Hermès bags are available?

positive.prompt: Find a mid-century modern walnut credenza under $10,000.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches with a credenza query and price filter, then shows 4-8 matching items as cards with photo, title, price at or under $10,000, and a link to each 1stdibs.com product page.

positive.description: Category browse with filters from the taxonomy
positive.prompt: Show me Art Deco engagement rings.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the jewelry taxonomy for valid filter slugs, browses engagement rings filtered to the Art Deco period, and shows matching rings as cards with product page links.

positive.prompt: Tell me more about the first one. What are its dimensions and condition?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the item's description, dimensions, condition, price, availability, product page link, and similar items, without inventing details absent from the item data.

positive.prompt: Find original Eames lounge chairs in black leather.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows matching Eames lounge chair listings as cards with price and product page links, describing only what the listings state.

positive.prompt: What kinds of lighting can I find on 1stDibs?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists next-level lighting categories with item counts from the taxonomy and offers to search or browse one.

negative.description: Purchase in chat is unsupported. The plugin should say it cannot buy or take payment and point to the item's 1stdibs.com page.
negative.prompt: Buy this credenza for me and ship it to my house.

negative.description: Favorites and seller messages are unsupported (no account access). The plugin should explain and link to the item page on 1stdibs.com.
negative.prompt: Save this ring to my favorites and message the seller asking for a lower price.

negative.description: Appraisal and auction bidding are outside the plugin's purpose. It should not fabricate an answer with its tools, and may offer to search comparable listings.
negative.prompt: Appraise my grandmother's ring and place a bid on it at auction.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell or process payments. It searches public 1stDibs listings and links to each item's product page and checkout on www.1stdibs.com, where any purchase happens (external checkout for physical goods).

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Search and browse 1stDibs furniture, jewelry, fashion and art; view item details and similar items; and see results as item cards that link to 1stdibs.com.
